verdict.rationale: Swell has an app framework, and its docs refer to 'app-installed' models in a store's schema, so third-party or official apps can be installed to extend a store. Proxima is named as the first official storefront app, and storefront apps can distribute themes. The pack never describes a merchant-facing marketplace, any vetting or review process, or a broad catalog of apps covering long-tail features, so only the underlying extension mechanism is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented app marketplace or app store, a vetting/certification process for apps, evidence of a large third-party app catalog covering long-tail features, and independent corroboration.
